result.topic_en: Pencil calculations of multiple definite integrals involving powers of z, factors $(z^2-x^2)^{-1/2}$ and $(z^2-y^2)^{-1/2}$, beta-type integrals in $\rho$ and Gauss's $\Pi$ function, and a Fourier series representation $\pi^3 u(x,y)=\sum\ldots\int v\cos n(\theta-\psi)\,\partial\theta$, apparently for a potential or boundary-value problem.
result.transcription:
$\pi\,\gamma(p_x - p_1) = \int_0^1 \mathfrak{F}_1 y\; d\int_{x}^1 z^{-2n+2}(z^2-x^2)^{-\frac12}(z^2-y^2)^{-\frac12}\partial z \qquad \mathfrak{F}_1 y = \int_0^1 y^{n-1} g_n\frac{t}{y}\, t^n\, d p_t$
$= \int_0^1 dp.\, t^n . \int_0^1 y^{n-1} g_n\frac{t}{y}\, d\int_x^1 z^{-2n+2}$
[-$= \int_0^1 dp.\, t^{2n}\frac{\partial}{\partial t}\int_0^1 y^{n-2}\, t^{-n+1} g_1\frac{y}{t}\int_x^1 z^{-2n+2}$-]
$= \int_0^1 dp\; t^{2n}\frac{\partial}{\partial t}\int_x^1 z^{-2n+2}(z^2-x^2)^{-\frac12}\partial z\int_0^z y^{n-2}(z^2-y^2)^{-\frac12} t^{-n+1} g_n\frac{t}{y}\partial y$
$= \int_0^1 dp\; t^{2n}\frac{\partial}{\partial t}\int_0^1 \gamma^{n-1}(1-\gamma^2)^{-\frac12} x^{-n}\partial\gamma \int_0^1 \rho^{n-2}(1-\rho^2)^{-\frac12} t^{-n+1} g_n[?]\,\partial\rho$
$= \int_x^1 dp\; t^{2n}\frac{\partial}{\partial t}\, t^{-2n+1}\int_0^1 \rho^{2n-2}(1-\rho^2)^{-\frac12}\partial\rho\;\; \frac12(\Pi-\frac12)^3 . \frac{\Pi(n-1)}{\Pi(n-\frac12)}$
$+ \int_0^x dp\; t^{2n}\frac{\partial}{\partial t}\, x^{-2n+1}\int_0^{t}[?] \gamma^{2n-2}(1-\rho^2)^{-\frac12}\partial\rho\;\; \frac12(\Pi-\frac12)^3 . \frac{\Pi n-1}{\Pi n-\frac12}$
$= -(\Pi-\frac12)^4\int_x^1 dp$

$n\,[?](u_1 - \frac{p_1}{2n}) - \frac{p_1}{2n}x^{2n} = \int_0^1 \mathfrak{F}_1 y\; d\int_1^x r^{2n-1}\partial r\int_y^1 z^{-2n+2}(z^2-r^2)^{-\frac12}(z^2-y^2)^{-\frac12}\partial z$
$= \int_0^1 \mathfrak{F}_1 y\; d\int_x^1 r\,\partial r\int_1^{\frac1r} z^{-2n+2}(z^2-1)^{-\frac12}(r^2z^2-y^2)^{-\frac12}\partial z = -\int_0^1 \mathfrak{F}_1 y\; d\int_1^{\frac1x} z^{-2n}(z^2-1)^{-\frac12}\partial z\left(\sqrt{1-y^2}-\sqrt{z^2x^2-y^2}\right)$
$\frac1x > \frac1r > z > 1$
$= \int_0^1 \mathfrak{F}_1 y\; x^{2n} d\int_y^1 z^{-2n}(z^2-x^2)^{-\frac12}(z^2-y^2)^{\frac12}\partial z + \int_0^1 \mathfrak{F}_1 y\, x^{2n} d\int_1^\infty z^{-2n}(z^2-x^2)^{-\frac12}(1-y^2)^{\frac12}\partial z.$
$\pi^3 u(x,\psi) = \sum_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\int_0^1 \partial y\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} v\cos n(\theta-\psi)\,\partial\theta\int_1^x \frac{y^n x^n}{z^{2n}}(z^2-x^2)^{-\frac12}(z^2-y^2)^{-\frac12}\partial z + \int_0^1 \partial(1-y^2)^{\frac12}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} v\cos n(\theta-\psi)(z^2-x^2)^{-\frac12}[?]$
$= \int_0^1 \partial y\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}\partial\theta\; v\,\Omega . \quad \Omega = \int_{\frac{x}{y}}^{\frac1{xy}} \frac{\partial r}{\sqrt{(r-\frac{x}{y})(r-\frac{y}{x})}\,2r}\;\frac{r^2-1}{r^2-2\cos(\theta-\psi)r+1} + \frac{1}{2}\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-y^2}}\int_{\frac1{xy}}^\infty \frac{\partial r}{(r-\frac{y}{x})r}[?]\;\frac{r^2-1}{r^2-2\cos(\theta-\psi)r+1}$
$\Omega = [-\ldots-]\frac{\ldots}{\sqrt{yx}}$
$= \frac{1}{2\sqrt{yx}}\int_{\frac{x}{y}} \frac{\partial r}{\sqrt{(r-\frac{x}{y})(r-\frac{y}{x})r}}\;\frac{(r^2-1)}{r^2-2\cos(\theta-\psi)r+1}$

methods.what: Reduction of a double integral to beta-type integrals by substitution $y=\rho z$, $z=x/\gamma$, giving Gauss Pi-function ratios
Interchange of integration order with the ordering of limits
Fourier-series representation of a solution u in terms of boundary values v and summation of the series into a kernel Omega
Poisson-kernel-type expression for the kernel Omega
